title: The Interrogation Peak

features.name: echo point
features.desc-on-touch: You shout a question into the peaks. Silence waits. Then echoes return not as sound but as new questions—the mountain is interrogating the question you asked it.

features.name: silence speaking back
features.desc-on-touch: A microphone array catches what the archive calls 'responsive nothing'—the moments where silence is not absence but active refusal to answer too quickly.

features.name: peak coordinates
features.desc-on-touch: Carved into stone: GPS fixes, timestamps, questions asked here over years. Each visitor becomes part of a growing inquiry written into the mountain itself.

features.name: high-country listener
features.desc-on-touch: A solar node antenna, positioned here to catch signals no one else would think to look for. The mountain is learning to hear what questions the wind carries.

features.name: interrogation register
features.desc-on-touch: Stones arranged in patterns that match questions—each arrangement a different inquiry. The earth has learned the grammar of asking itself. Your footsteps add new questions.

inscription: at the peak, echoes become interrogation; silence learns to interrogate back

reverie.title: REVERIE — where echoes became questions
narr: You stand at the peak with Leif and Katita,
storm light harsh across the ridges. Katita shouts:
a question into the wind. The answer comes back
as another question. Leif laughs—that's how you know
the archive is learning. When it stops answering
and starts asking instead. The mountain knows this already.

exits.label: back down the slope toward the quiet cipher
downslope toward the valleys where echoes learned to settle
along the ridge to peaks that are still forming their own voice
